3) Is there a preferred timeline for the security review (target sign-off date)?

Hi Samir / Camila  apologies for the slightly delayed reply, pulled a few artifacts for you.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025; attached is a redacted SOC 2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf). We can provide a bridge letter and arrange an NDA/secure review of the full report if procurement requires it.
- PHI / HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads. We recommend scoping production inference to encrypted-in-transit and encrypted-at-rest storage. We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via our KMS integrations  there is a short onboarding window (~2–3 weeks) to validate key rotation and access controls for a new customer. For PHI handling, we'll want to confirm whether tokens/IDs are stored in logs/replicas; we can disable persistence for fields you mark as PHI.
- Data residency: We can provision EU-only capacity (Ireland and Germany regions) for customer datasets and inference endpoints. There are region-specific SLAs and minor latency tradeoffs; our ops team can pin the model serving cluster to DE/IE per your requirement.
- Subprocessors: Attaching current subprocessor roster in the SIG and can provide a redacted list for procurement review.

I filled the security control sections in the attached SIG spreadsheet with standard answers and flagged five items where we need more detail from your side before finalizing:
1) Environment containing PHI (prod vs staging)  please confirm which environments will carry PHI and whether test data will contain live PHI.
2) Retention windows for processed outputs (how long does Vitalscope need inference outputs retained?).
3) Specific EU country residency constraint (DE/IE ok  confirm primary preference).
4) Required encryption algorithms or KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP CMEK supported).
5) Any additional regulatory controls beyond HIPAA (e.g., regional patient consent rules).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (redacted), Redwood_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (filled draft), Redwood_DataFlow_Diagram.png

Next steps: I can join a 30-minute call Friday 10/16 at 9:00 AM PT to walk the SIG and the redacted SOC2; let me know if that works for your team and we'll send a calendar invite. If you prefer email, please reply with answers to the five flagged items and we'll push a completed SIG within 3 business days.
